name: Icegram Mailer – Reliable Email Deliverability, No-code SMTP Replacement & Email logs
author: Icegram

sections.description:
Send emails directly from your WordPress dashboard with Icegram Mailer.

Mailer is an email sending service for WordPress and WooCommerce. Set it up once and send emails reliably without any external SMTP plugins.

Get accurate email logs and real-time delivery insights, with up to 200 emails / month included on the free plan.

1,000,000+ emails delivered 🚀 – No extra tools. No ongoing configuration!

Perfect For

  • Busy site owners and digital marketers
  • Bloggers and content creators
  • WooCommerce store owners
  • Agencies and developers
  • Anyone facing email delivery challenges
  • Users of email marketing plugins like MailPoet, Icegram Express, MailChimp, etc.

Key Features: Empower Your Email Sending

  • Quick Start with Free Emails:
    ➜ Connect to Icegram’s built-in sending service. Start with 200 free emails and scale with monthly plans when needed.

  • Reliable Email Delivery:
    ➜ Emails are sent securely and consistently, no external SMTP plugins required.

  • Email Logging & Insights:
    ➜ Track sent and opened emails with clear logs and delivery insights.

  • One-Time Setup:
    ➜ Install and configure once from your WordPress dashboard. No ongoing maintenance.

  • Works across your stack:
    ➜ Compatible with leading WordPress and WooCommerce email and marketing plugins.

Icegram Mailer is available in Dutch and English.

Why Do Others Love Icegram Mailer?

  • “Very fast resolution to my email problem” – Dr. Cecil W. Thorn
  • “Works flawlessly and also with PHP Mailer” – Fenix71
  • “Best email sending service so far” – Shashank2910
  • “ICEGRAM for life” – vginasands

Versatile Email Capabilities: What Can You Send?

Icegram Mailer handles both marketing and transactional email from a single setup:

  • Marketing Emails: Newsletters, promotions, and product updates.

  • Transactional Emails: Order confirmations, invoices, and account notices.

  • System Emails: Password resets and critical alerts.

  • eCommerce Alerts: Cart recovery and shipping updates.

Why Choose Mailer?

✨ Fast & Reliable Delivery:
Send emails through Icegram’s built-in service, without external SMTP tools.

📊 Clear, Actionable Insights:
Access detailed reports to understand performance and spot issues early.

⚙️ One-time Setup:
Configure once and send without recurring maintenance or third-party dependencies.

🔄 Broad Compatibility:
Works with leading email and marketing plugins for WordPress and WooCommerce.

🆓 Try Mailer today for better results guaranteed!

Works With All Your Favorite WordPress Plugins

How It Works: Get Started in Under 5 Minutes

Install & Activate:
👉 Install Mailer directly from your WordPress dashboard in seconds.

Configure Settings:
👉 Create your one-time account, activate your free plan of 200 emails, and choose your preferred sending plan.

Monitor & Analyze:
👉 Access real-time email logs and detailed delivery reports from your dashboard.

Scale Effortlessly:
👉 Upgrade to a paid plan as your email-sending needs grow for uninterrupted, high-performance delivery.

Icegram Mailer: Who is This For?

Icegram Mailer is built for teams that depend on email and need predictable delivery inside WordPress.

  • WooCommerce Store Owners
    You send order confirmations, invoices, and shipping updates daily. Failed emails create support tickets and lost trust. Icegram Mailer keeps transactional emails fast and reliable, even during high volume.

  • Marketing Teams Running WordPress Newsletters
    You use plugins like Icegram Express, MailPoet, or Newsletter. You want campaigns to go out on time without worrying about SMTP limits or delivery gaps. Icegram Mailer handles sending so you can focus on content and performance.

  • SaaS And Product Teams Using WordPress
    You rely on system emails for onboarding, password resets, and account alerts. Icegram Mailer gives you visibility into delivery and logs, so issues are spotted early, not after users complain.

  • Growing Businesses Outgrowing Basic SMTP Setups
    You’ve hit limits, inconsistencies, or deliverability issues with generic SMTP tools. Icegram Mailer replaces fragile setups with a single, stable sending layer.

  • Teams That Want Fewer Tools And Less Maintenance
    You prefer one-time setup, built-in sending, and clear reporting, without managing third-party services or recurring configurations.

Dedicated Support

Our support team is committed to your success. After all, we are humans, not bots!
You can easily reach us, and we’ll respond within 48 hours!

Get Started Today

Upgrade your email-sending process with Icegram Mailer, the ultimate Email Sending Service for WordPress.

What’s Next

If you love Mailer, check out our other powerful plugins from Icegram:

  • Icegram Express: The ultimate email marketing & automation plugin for WordPress.

  • Icegram Engage: Boost conversions with popups, welcome bars, and advanced lead generation.

  • Icegram Collect: Capture and convert leads with our feature-rich forms plugin.

  • Temporary Login Without Password: Create temporary, self-expiring accounts for secure, passwordless WordPress access—no permanent accounts required.

Icegram Mailer is your all-in-one email sending solution—instant, dependable, and built to scale.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload icegram-mailer.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Place <?php do_action('plugin_name_hook'); ?> in your templates
sections.faq:
What is Icegram Mailer?

A: Mailer is a standalone Email Sending Service that resolves email delivery issues and provides real-time tracking—without the need for an external SMTP plugin.

How many emails can I send with the trial plan?

A: The trial plan allows you to send 200 emails, so you can test the service before upgrading.

Is Mailer compatible with other email marketing plugins?

A: Yes, Mailer works seamlessly with MailPoet, Icegram Express, MailChimp, FluentCRM, Constant Contact, ActiveCampaign, and other leading email marketing plugins on WordPress and WooCommerce.

How do I monitor my email campaigns?

A: You can view detailed logs and analytics directly from your WordPress dashboard to monitor delivery, opens, and other key metrics.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Fix: Resolved “API key is empty” error when sending emails in some cases
  • Update: Tested up to WordPress 6.9

1.0.7

  • New: Added translations for Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German

1.0.6

  • Update: Added POT file for translations

1.0.5

  • Improvement: Separation between frontend and backend processes for improved performance and flexibility.
  • Update: Tested up to WordPress 6.8

1.0.4

  • Fix: Email stats calculation issue on some sites

1.0.3

  • Fix: Registration error when site title is empty
  • Fix: Signup error when Icegram email sending service is already being used in Icegram Express plugin

1.0.2

  • Fix: Incorrect “Reply-To” email in some cases

1.0.1

  • Update: UI improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release
